output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is set to 5000000000, and the totalSupply is mintedAmount * 10 ** uint256(decimals), where mintedAmount can be manipulated by attackers. If mintedAmount is sufficiently large, the totalSupply value can overflow and become very small, causing a devaluation of the token.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _transfer function asserts that balanceOf[_from] >= _value && balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to], which can be manipulated by attackers to overflow balanceOf[_to] if it is sufficiently small.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _transfer function asserts that balanceOf[_from] >= _value && balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to], which can be manipulated by attackers to overflow balanceOf[_to] if it is sufficiently small.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply -= _value; can underflow if _value is larger than balanceOf[msg.sender], causing a devaluation of the token.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value <= allowance[msg.sender][msg.sender] && balanceOf[_from] >= _value; can underflow if _value is larger than balanceOf[_from], causing a devaluation of the token.
